config.script: popup.notification.info("1 Grupo de Máquinas", "1 Grupo de Máquinas", "info")

onChange.script:
patch = self.session.custom.metricPatch
	if not patch:
		return
	cards = self.getChild('Main').getChild('FlexContainer').getChild('FlexContainer_0').getChild('Cards')
	metrics.service.patch_repeater(cards, patch.get('machineTitle'), patch.get('selectedKeys'), patch.get('context') or {})

messageHandlers.script:
context = {
		'machineId': payload['machineId'],
		'udtPath': payload['udtPath'],
		'database': payload['database'],
		'title': payload['machineTitle'],
	}
	cards = self.getChild('Main').getChild('FlexContainer').getChild('FlexContainer_0').getChild('Cards')
	metrics.service.patch_repeater(cards, payload['machineTitle'], payload['selectedKeys'], context)
